quotes.name: Lena Okafor
quotes.quote: To be honest, I don't really see a connection between my performance in UNDOCKED and my role as a Daycare Director. I mean, they're just two different things I do. One is a hobby, really, and the other is my job. I enjoy flying on UNDOCKED, it's a way for me to unwind and challenge myself, but it doesn't directly relate to how I manage the daycare.
